dataclass Attestation
  by: str
  verified: bool
  hop: int
  program: str
  host: str
  user: str
  exe: str
  uid: int
  gid: int
  pid: int
  key: str
  mac: str
class DispatchError(ValueError)
  __init__(code)
const HISTORY_CURSOR_WORDS
const HISTORY_ERROR_CODES
class HistoryObserver
  observe(cursor: str, max_records: int, max_bytes: int, wait_ms: int) -> Page
class HistoryObserverClient(HistoryObserver)
  __init__(transport)
  observe(cursor: str, max_records: int, max_bytes: int, wait_ms: int) -> Page
class HistoryReader
  read(cursor: str, max_records: int, max_bytes: int) -> Page
class HistoryReaderClient(HistoryReader)
  __init__(transport)
  read(cursor: str, max_records: int, max_bytes: int) -> Page
dataclass Page
  outcome: PageOutcome | None
  records: list[Record]
  next: str
  at_end: bool
enum PageOutcome
  PAGE = 'page'
  GAP = 'gap'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  INVALID_REQUEST = 'invalid_request'
  RECORD_TOO_LARGE = 'record_too_large'
  CORRUPT = 'corrupt'
  UNSUPPORTED = 'unsupported'
dataclass Record
  schema: int
  time: str
  level: int
  msg: str
  identity: list[Attestation]
  job: str
  attrs: dict[str, str]
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
class ServiceError(Exception)
  __init__(code, message)
enum ServiceErrorCode
  HANDLER_ERROR = 'handler_error'
  INVALID_RESULT = 'invalid_result'
  UNKNOWN_VERSION = 'unknown_version'
  UNKNOWN_SERVICE = 'unknown_service'
  UNKNOWN_METHOD = 'unknown_method'
  WRONG_MODE = 'wrong_mode'
  CALLER_UNAVAILABLE = 'caller_unavailable'
  IDENTITY_REQUIRED = 'identity_required'
  WRONG_USER = 'wrong_user'
  POLICY_UNAVAILABLE = 'policy_unavailable'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
class Sink
  write(record: Record) -> None
class SinkClient(Sink)
  __init__(transport)
  write(record: Record) -> None
def decode(data)
def encode(v)
def service_name(frame)
